faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: Have questions about how NotaKu works or its subscription plans? Find answers here.

items.q: Is NotaKu truly free to use?
items.a: Yes! You can use the Free plan forever without a credit card. It includes up to 5 invoices per month, basic client management, PDF export, and WhatsApp sharing.

items.q: What are the benefits of upgrading to NotaKu PRO?
items.a: With NotaKu PRO (only Rp49,000 / 30 days), you get unlimited invoice creation, watermark-free PDF exports, custom logo, draw-canvas digital signature, official company stamp, and CSV financial reports.

items.q: What payment methods are supported for PRO upgrades?
items.a: We use Mayar.id official payment gateway supporting QRIS (GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay, LinkAja), National Bank Virtual Accounts (BCA, Mandiri, BRI, BNI, Permata), and Credit Cards.

items.q: How do I send invoices to clients via WhatsApp?
items.a: After creating an invoice, simply click 'Share WhatsApp'. NotaKu will automatically compose a neat message with invoice details and an interactive public link for your client.
